newsitem.title: USA: Commonwealth Edison says operator tests continuing.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth Edison says operator tests continuing.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co, a unit of Unicom Corp, said its mid-term simulator tests for operators at its LaSalle nuclear power plant have not been canceled as reported Wednesday.

The utility said the High Intensity Training Program was administered to 31 plant operators and 25 of them will require additional training. ComEd plans to continue testing the remaining 29 operators.
The Chicago Sun-Times reported Wednesday that the program has been canceled and will be redesigned.
The training was created to address regulatory and other concerns about performance, communications, procedure adherence and control issues, ComEd said.
The results of the exam will be evaluated once all of the crews have been tested and the program will be adjusted to make sure the identified issues are addressed, ComEd said.
Unicom is an energy holding company.
Its shares closed off 1/8 Wednesday at 19-5/8.
